rows.q: What was total revenue in 2024 Q3?
rows.sql:
SELECT SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue
FROM v_sales
WHERE year = 2024
  AND quarter = 3;

rows.q: How many orders were placed in 2025?
Which region had the lowest revenue in 2024 Q3?
rows.sql:
SELECT region
FROM v_sales
WHERE year = 2024
  AND quarter = 3
GROUP BY region
ORDER BY SUM(revenue) ASC
LIMIT 1;

rows.q: What is our gross margin percentage for 2025?
rows.sql:
SELECT
  ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(gross_profit) / NULLIF(SUM(revenue), 0),
    2
  ) AS gross_margin_percentage
FROM v_sales
WHERE year = 2025;

rows.q: How many distinct SKUs did we sell in 2023?
Which category made the most gross profit in 2025 Q4?
rows.sql:
SELECT category
FROM v_sales
WHERE year = 2025
  AND quarter = 4
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY SUM(gross_profit) DESC
LIMIT 1;

rows.q: What was Voss Industrial's revenue in 2025?
rows.sql:
SELECT SUM(revenue) AS revenue
FROM v_sales
WHERE customer = 'Voss Industrial'
  AND year = 2025;

rows.q: How many customers are in the Midwest region?
rows.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM customers c
JOIN regions r ON c.region_id = r.region_id
WHERE r.name = 'Midwest';

rows.q: What was the average discount percentage in 2024?
Which channel produced the most orders overall?
rows.sql:
SELECT channel
FROM orders
GROUP BY channel
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, channel
LIMIT 1;

rows.q: How much revenue came from the Enterprise segment in 2024 Q2?
rows.sql:
SELECT SUM(revenue) AS revenue
FROM v_sales
WHERE segment = 'Enterprise'
  AND year = 2024
  AND quarter = 2;

rows.q: How many units of Safety products shipped in 2025 Q1?
rows.sql:
SELECT SUM(qty) AS units_shipped
FROM v_sales
WHERE category = 'Safety'
  AND year = 2025
  AND quarter = 1;

rows.q: What is the total cost of goods sold across all time?
rows.sql:
SELECT SUM(cost) AS total_cost_of_goods_sold
FROM v_sales;

rows.q: Which supplier has the most products?
rows.sql:
SELECT s.name AS supplier, COUNT(*) AS product_count
FROM products p
JOIN suppliers s ON s.supplier_id = p.supplier_id
GROUP BY s.supplier_id, s.name
ORDER BY product_count DESC, s.name
LIMIT 1;

rows.q: What was Southwest region revenue in 2023 Q4?
rows.sql:
SELECT SUM(revenue) AS southwest_region_revenue
FROM v_sales
WHERE region = 'Southwest'
  AND year = 2023
  AND quarter = 4;

rows.q: How many order lines had a discount of 15 percent?
What was gross profit in 2024 Q4?
rows.sql:
SELECT SUM(gross_profit) AS gross_profit
FROM v_sales
WHERE year = 2024
  AND quarter = 4;

rows.q: Which region grew revenue most between 2023 and 2025?
rows.sql:
SELECT region
FROM (
  SELECT
    region,
    SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2025 THEN revenue ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2023 THEN revenue ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_growth
  FROM v_sales
  WHERE year IN (2023, 2025)
  GROUP BY region
  ORDER BY revenue_growth DESC
  LIMIT 1
);

rows.q: How many suppliers are based outside the United States?
What was the average order value in 2025 Q2?
rows.sql:
SELECT AVG(order_total) AS average_order_value
FROM (
  SELECT order_id, SUM(revenue) AS order_total
  FROM v_sales
  WHERE year = 2025
    AND quarter = 2
  GROUP BY order_id
);
